mapper.select: SELECT st.table_id, st.store_id, st.table_info, st.capacity, st.pos_x, st.pos_y FROM reservation_table rt JOIN store_tables st ON rt.table_id = st.table_id WHERE rt.reservation_id = #{reservationId}

SELECT reservation_id, member_id, store_id, reservation_time, guest_count, status, cancelled_reason, created_at FROM reservations WHERE store_id = #{storeId} ORDER BY reservation_time DESC, created_at DESC
SELECT reservation_id, member_id, store_id, reservation_time, guest_count, status, cancelled_reason, created_at FROM reservations WHERE reservation_id = #{reservationId}

SELECT reservation_id, member_id, store_id, reservation_time, guest_count, status, cancelled_reason, created_at FROM reservations WHERE store_id = #{storeId} AND DATE(reservation_time) = #{date} ORDER BY reservation_time ASC
SELECT table_id, store_id, table_info, capacity, pos_x, pos_y FROM store_tables WHERE store_id = #{storeId} ORDER BY table_id
SELECT table_id, store_id, table_info, capacity, pos_x, pos_y FROM store_tables WHERE table_id = #{tableId}
SELECT reservation_id, member_id, store_id, reservation_time, guest_count, status, cancelled_reason, created_at FROM reservations WHERE member_id = #{memberId} ORDER BY reservation_time DESC
SELECT * FROM reservation WHERE payment_id = #{paymentId} AND status = 'PENDING'
mapper.update: UPDATE members SET manner_temperature = GREATEST(manner_temperature + 1, 0) WHERE member_id = ( SELECT member_id FROM reservations WHERE reservation_id = #{reservationId} )
UPDATE members SET manner_temperature = GREATEST(manner_temperature - 1, 0) WHERE member_id = ( SELECT member_id FROM reservations WHERE reservation_id = #{reservationId} )
mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM reservations WHERE store_id = #{storeId} AND DATE(reservation_date) = CURDATE() AND status = 'CONFIRMED'
